additional_info.subject: RE: 0430668 - ID0429525-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / N5 160345946] Charging issue (C1) CRM:00646000038
additional_info.body:
Dear Ferdinand,
As we discussed today, I did some deeper analysis on the logs, and luckily, I was able to monitor a live charging session now (2025-06-16T12:45:11.181Z). Please be aware that the PowerConverter[6] behaves abnormally after the E17 error flag and is unable to build the battery voltage after error flags become false. This is leading to the abnormal behavior from the charger. As the affected converter is in DC2, the power reduction will not help us. Please plan to replace the power converter ASAP.
Unfortunately, I could not observe the charging session from beginning but I would like to observe the same, incase if you are able to align with the customer (For record purpose).
Thank you very much for being understanding and patient.
Please find the power converter details for your reference:
2102312VGQ10L6000024SA002200000000FW:DC108PF108H100,F:1 .
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
